comment: Slices of the .NET libraries' tests on WitOS (plan step R7.3), which @Docs/Implementation/R7.3-Library-Tests.md explains. projects: upstream's library test projects runtime-witos builds for witos and the guest runs under xunit's console runner, a process a project, without the categories upstream's CI leaves out. excluded: test methods (xunit's -nomethod names or patterns) the guest leaves out, each with the reason. Every other test must pass.

excluded.System.Numerics.Tests.ToStringTest.RunRe: formats in the en-US culture: globalization is invariant, since the system layer has no ICU (RFC 0015 section 8)
builds a BigInteger of 2^31 bits twice, 256 MB each, past the pages a process commits (the system layer's quota, 256 MiB)
